PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPolicy.companyItem0: Full legal name: STRIDON GROUP DOO
PrivacyPolicy.companyItem2: Activity and activity code: 4615 – Mediation in sale of furniture, household goods and metal goods
PrivacyPolicy.section0Heading: Notice on protection of personal data
PrivacyPolicy.section0Content0: Personal data you provide to the site for the purpose of obtaining products or services will be treated in accordance with our data privacy document. It is prohibited to send or transmit to or from this location any unlawful, threatening, abusive, defamatory, obscene, pornographic or other materials contrary to any law.
PrivacyPolicy.section0Content1: Stridon Group does not wish to receive from you on this site any confidential or other information that it cannot freely dispose of. All materials, information or other communications you transmit or send to this site will not be considered confidential or non-freely disposable.
PrivacyPolicy.section0Content2: Your personal data, in accordance with the Privacy Policy, we use only for internal purposes. We do not disclose or forward it to third parties, but use it exclusively for the purposes of processing your orders.
PrivacyPolicy.section1Heading: Type of data collected and purpose of collection
PrivacyPolicy.section1Content0: Data collected through the contact form (name, surname, email, phone number, city and residential address) will be used by Stridon Group for the purpose of preparing and informing users about the offer of a particular product, arranging delivery and sending responses to user inquiries. Data collected this way will not be transferred by Stridon Group to third parties. The legal basis for collecting customer data is consent, legitimate interest or conclusion and execution of a contract.
PrivacyPolicy.section2Content0: Data users are our employees, who use your data for the purpose of fulfilling your order.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Content0: Your data will be adequately protected on our server with antivirus protection and physical/technical protection of the premises, as long as our employees have access to them.
PrivacyPolicy.section4Content0: You have the right to receive confirmation of whether we process your personal data, the right of access, the right to rectification, the right to request termination of processing and the right to erasure of your data. You can exercise all rights by contacting: office@stridon.rs or phone +381-64-616-5003.
PrivacyPolicy.section5Content0: Parts of our website use cookies. A cookie is a text file stored locally on your computer that enables recognition of a returning user. The website uses cookies to remember what you have done on it and what your preferred options are. If you do not wish to accept cookies, you can disable them in your internet browser.
PrivacyPolicy.section6Content0: The content of this website is legally protected and exclusively copyrighted and belongs to Stridon Group doo. Unauthorized copying, reproduction, public display or distribution of website content in any manner is prohibited.
